question.text: Realisation value of officially listed futures or options contracts of a Cat III AIF is determined on the basis of:

answer.text: Latest available settlement prices on the stock exchange where the fund trades
Last traded price of one month ago

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the chapter: 'The realisation value of futures or options contracts officially listed on a market or traded on a regulated market shall be determined on the basis of the latest available settlement prices of these contracts on the stock exchanges and market on which the Fund trades the contracts.' The Trap: In-house pricing models and broker indicative quotes are used for non-listed/OTC derivatives, not for exchange-traded contracts. A one-month-old last traded price is not the latest available settlement price. Note: For listed futures and options the settlement price published by the exchange where the fund trades is the prescribed input for valuation.
